🆕 WHAT'S NEW

Open Water Swim Planner — Version 2.7.1

Here’s what’s new in this release:

  • 🌍
    Ukrainian language added
    Ukrainian is now available throughout the app, including menus, forecasts and dynamic information.
  • 🏞️
    Improved lake information
    Lake wind assessments are now location-specific. Youghal Quay keeps its local wind guidance; Twomilegate uses its known east/north-east exposure; other lakes do not receive invented compass-direction claims.
  • 🇺🇦
    Ukraine locations updated
    Blue Lake and Gloria Lake are now identified as Kyiv Ukraine.
  • 🌡️
    Lake water-temperature information
    Water temperature is shown only where reliable location-specific information is available.
  • 📱
    Improved app updates
    The app version and release notification are now kept in sync so new releases can be clearly identified.
Thanks for using Open Water Swim Planner. 🌊

📖 How to Use the Swim Planner

📱 Phone

  1. Choose your swim location. Youghal Quay is the default location when the app opens. Select another sea or lake location from the location menu if required.
  2. View the forecast. The forecast loads automatically when you choose a location. The 7-day forecast is the main view.
  3. Select a day. Tap a forecast day to open the information for that day. If the selected day is today, it is shown as Today.
  4. Current conditions. Current conditions and the Swim Recommendation are kept out of the main phone view to reduce clutter. They remain available on the main desktop view.
  5. Sea locations — Tide Info. When viewing a sea forecast day, choose the tide option if you want tide information for that date.
  6. Sea locations — Make Travel Plans. Select Make travel plans for the forecast day. You will first be asked to choose the high tide you want to swim for. After selecting the tide, continue to the Journey Planner to see the travel plan.
  7. Lake locations. Lake forecasts do not use sea tide information. Select a forecast day to see the lake information for that date.
  8. Close a pop-up. Use the Close button or X when available.

🖥️ Desktop PC

  1. Choose your swim location. Youghal Quay is the default location when the app opens. Selecting a location automatically loads its current conditions, Swim Recommendation and forecast.
  2. View the forecast. The 7-day forecast is displayed for the selected location. Select a forecast day to view the detailed information for that day. If the selected day is today, it is shown as Today.
  3. Sea locations — Tide Info. For sea locations, use Click for tide info when you want to see the tide information. It opens in a separate panel so the main forecast screen stays uncluttered.
  4. Sea locations — Journey Planner. Use Click to plan your journey when you want to open the Journey Planner in a separate panel.
  5. Close information panels. Use the X/Close control in the panel. You can also click outside the panel to close it.
  6. Lake locations. Lake locations do not display the sea Tide Info or Journey Planner buttons. The lake forecast is presented using lake-specific information.
  7. Units. Use the Units option in the header menu to switch between Metric (km, °C, metres) and Imperial (miles, °F, feet). Wind speed changes between m/s and mph.
  8. Light / Dark theme. Use the theme option in the header to switch themes. Dark theme is the default.
  9. App information. Open the menu to access this guide and see the current App Version.
⚠️ Forecast guidance only

Forecast conditions can change, particularly several days in advance. Predictions are a guide only and should not be relied upon as an assessment of swimming safety. Always check the latest forecast and local conditions before swimming.
